message: binwalk exited successfully but left no usable report (Report was not created), so inspect_firmware_regions produced no Evidence. A successful exit status is not an empty or complete result.

remediation.action: Review diagnostics.report_state, the exit status and captured stdout/stderr. REA did not retry or substitute an empty result. diagnostics.command and diagnostics.args record what ran; their workspace paths are REA-private and removed after the attempt, so they cannot be replayed as-is. Rerun the same REA request to check whether this is intermittent; each attempt uses a fresh workspace. If it recurs, copy the selected input bytes into a new directory and run diagnostics.command with the same flags, replacing every private path with your copy and a new report path, under the documented firmware resource limits; confirm that it writes the requested report. `rea doctor` checks configuration only and cannot recover this report.

details.reason: binwalk exited 0 without a usable report: Report was not created
